Road accidents claim lives and injure others across India

Multiple road accidents have been reported across India, resulting in fatalities and injuries. In one incident, a car collided with a parked trailer, leaving three individuals seriously injured. In another, a collision involving a motorcycle and an unidentified vehicle led to two deaths. These events highlight ongoing road safety concerns.
